name: Taifa of Saltés and Huelva
alt: Taifa Kingdom of Saltés and Huelva

predecessors.name: Caliphate of Córdoba
predecessors.text: the coast around Saltés and Huelva

successors.name: Taifa of Seville
successors.text: the whole first taifa, taken in 1051

successors.name: Almohad Caliphate
successors.text: the second taifa (unverified), ended by the Almohads

ledger.x: 1012: the Bakrid taifa of Saltés and Huelva breaks away from the Caliphate of Córdoba.
1147: a second Taifa of Saltés and Huelva appears in Cliopatria.
1151: the second taifa ends, taken by the Almohads.

wars.name: Abbadid conquest of Saltés and Huelva
wars.outcome: Seville conquered the taifa in 1051 and held it to 1091.

certainty.note: The pages give the capital and the taifa's name only; the estuary coast is firm, the inland frontier with Badajoz and Niebla approximate.
